completeness_scope: extant generated scene and scene/prompt/case/prepared metadata in the inventoried project tree
exposed_scene_count_semantics: conservative generated-scene superset, not demonstrated model-call count
limitations: Deleted, inaccessible and external historical metadata cannot be certified.
Archived copies and raw model output trees are not reparsed; all extant generated metadata is conservatively excluded.
Completeness is metadata-inventory scoped, not a universal claim about every historical exposure.
